item.title: Govt Sends Plea to Kenyans in Middle East as Bombing Escalates
item.description: The plea comes as bombs fall in various capitals in the Middle East, including Doha and Tehran, sending panic in the region.

item.title: Nairobi Water & Sewer Bills Set to Jump by Ksh23 and Ksh15 for Low Consumption Households
item.description: According to a notice by WASREB, customers with non-functional meters shall be billed based on the average of the last three months’ bills.

item.title: Helicopter Crashes and Bursts Into Flames in Nandi
item.description: The plane is said to have dropped from the sky on the evening of Saturday, February 28, it is unclear who was in the plane.

item.title: MP Among Six Killed in Plane Crash
item.description: Sources have told this publication police are working to identify the bodies of four other individuals said to have been on the ill-fated plane.

item.title: Nairobi Water Company to Roll Out Smart Meters
item.description: Unlike traditional mechanical meters that rely on moving parts, ultrasonic meters calculate consumption by sending sound waves through flowing water.

item.title: Wetang’ula Forms Special Team After Death of Emurua Dikirr MP Johana Ng’eno
item.description: Ng'eno is among six people who were aboard the helicopter that crashed and burst into flames on Saturday evening in Chepkiep, Mosop Sub-county.

item.title: Inside Final Moments of Emurua Dikirr MP Johana Ng’eno Before Fatal Helicopter Crash
item.description: The MP lost his life alongside five others after the helicopter he was travelling in crashed in Mosop, Nandi County, shortly after attempting to take off following an emergency landing prompted by poor weather conditions.

item.title: Ministry Issues Travel Advisory for Kenyans Abroad Amid Rising Israel-Iran Tensions
item.description: It is estimated that over 66,000 Kenyans are living and working in Qatar, while between 23,000 and 40,000 are in the UAE.

item.title: Millions Kenyans Bagged After Historic Podium Finishes at Tokyo Marathon 2026

item.title: Transport Ministry Proposes New Rules for Roadside Stations Along Major Highways
item.description: Transport Cabinet Secretary Davis Chirchir said that the framework is aimed at enhancing road safety by ensuring drivers have access to rest facilities
